sentences.text: Walking thirty minutes a day is good for your health.
sentences.translation: 每天步行三十分钟对健康有益。

sentences.text: Drinking enough water keeps your body healthy.
sentences.translation: 喝足够的水让身体保持健康。

sentences.text: A good night's sleep improves your memory.
sentences.translation: 良好的睡眠能改善记忆力。

sentences.text: Eating more vegetables helps you stay fit.
sentences.translation: 多吃蔬菜有助于保持身材。

sentences.text: Taking breaks from your screen protects your eyes.
sentences.translation: 让眼睛远离屏幕、适当休息可以保护视力。
